concerns.text: FR-005 requires a statistical test 'prioritizing Mann-Whitney U test or bootstrapping', but T015 implements 'bootstrapping ONLY … no Mann-Whitney U or normality-conditional t-test paths'. As written, no task can satisfy FR-005; either add a Mann-Whitney U path task or the spec must be narrowed (spec-side fix).

Tasks are tagged [FR-007] but spec.md's requirements end at FR-006 — FR-007 does not exist in the spec. Stale tag: the Pearson-correlation work (Constitution VII, plan Phase 3) is covered by T013/T016, but the traceability tag references a nonexistent requirement ID. Add FR-007 to the spec or re-anchor the tags to Constitution VII / plan Phase 3.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs constitution.md:Data Hygiene / data-model.md:Data Hygiene
concerns.text: No task records SHA-256 checksums of files under data/processed/ or updates the state artifact_hashes map. The data model states 'All generated files in data/processed/ are checksummed (SHA-256)' and the constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed — this plan element has no covering task.

Constitution requires requirements.txt to 'pin every Python dependency', but T004 specifies '>=' version ranges (e.g. transformers>=4.40.0), which are not pins; no task produces exact '==' pins or a lockfile, so the constitution's reproducibility requirement is uncovered.

T016's noise-robustness check references 'randomly swapped retrieved skills' — 'skills' is undefined in spec/plan/data model (spec uses retrieved context/chunks, S_t). Minor terminology mismatch that obscures which plan element this check traces to.
